subject: math
description: Build complete two-column triangle congruence proofs using givens, shared parts, vertical angles, congruence shortcuts, and CPCTC.
learningObjectives: Identify the givens and prove statement in a triangle congruence proof
Use reflexive shared parts and vertical angles as proof evidence
Choose a valid triangle congruence shortcut: SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, or HL
Organize a two-column proof with statements and valid reasons
Use CPCTC after proving triangles congruent
Recognize and correct invalid proof shortcuts such as SSA
prerequisites: Name corresponding parts of triangles in the correct order
Identify congruent segments and congruent angles from markings
Apply SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, and HL congruence conditions
Use the Vertical Angles Theorem and Reflexive Property
Understand statements and reasons in geometry proofs
